content: 1. Adolescents should engage in at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity every day. 2. Monitoring blood glucose levels before, during, and after exercise is of critical importance. 3. Providing education on glycemic targets in relation to physical activity is essential for both young individuals and their caregivers. 4. It is crucial to pay close attention to the risk of hypoglycemia, particularly following exercise.
